name: @khorsheed/dsh-mission-tool
description: The session-granted mission model tools, companion to @khorsheed/dsh-mission: a tool-only row (provides no service) that agent presets compose to grant the mission queue tools (`tools`: all / read / none) per session, plus their tool-guidance prompt section. Deliberately NOT self-mounting — installing it as a dependency only makes the module resolvable; an agent preset's agent.cordis.yml references the row by name.

compat.notes: Host-plane companion row: provides no service, registers the mission model tools into the host tools registry and contributes the `tool:mission` prompt section, so agent presets may compose it bare (the official tool-row shape). Probes the global `ctx.mission` service at apply time and silently skips registration when the core plugin is absent — a preset naming this row still mounts cleanly. No browser half: the 任务 tab UI lives in the core package.
